name: Chatbot Arena
intro: Chatbot Arena 是实时众包的匿名模型对战平台：用户向两个隐藏身份的模型提交同一段多轮对话并投票，身份关键词过滤保持匿名性，安全审核独立标记 3% 的不安全请求；异常 IP 的独立分析用于验证检测方法，不是排名输入过滤器。
build_method: 实时匿名双模型对战, 众包成对偏好投票, 模型/公司身份关键词过滤, OpenAI 安全审核标记, 异常 IP 独立分析, 非均匀模型对采样与重加权 Bradley–Terry 估计
metric: Bradley–Terry score, win rate, confidence interval
task_type: 开放式对话, 偏好评测
eval_feature: 实时开放问题, 多轮对话, 人工偏好, 匿名模型对, 专家一致性验证
scale: 论文快照超过240,000张选票, 600个主题簇
build_method_en: Live anonymous pairwise battles, crowdsourced preference votes, model/company identity-keyword filtering, OpenAI safety flagging, independent anomalous-IP analysis, and non-uniform pair sampling with reweighted Bradley–Terry estimation
eval_feature_en: Live Open-ended Prompts, Multi-turn Dialogue, Human Preference, Anonymous Model Pairs, Expert-agreement Validation
intro_en: Chatbot Arena is a live crowdsourced platform for anonymous model battles. Users send the same multi-turn conversation to two identity-hidden models and vote. Identity-keyword filtering preserves anonymity, a safety flag marks the 3% unsafe requests, and anomalous-IP independent analysis validates a detection method without acting as a ranking-input filter.
scale_en: More than 240,000 votes in the paper snapshot, 600 topic clusters
metric_en: Bradley–Terry Score, Win Rate, Confidence Interval

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2403.04132v1, §§3–7 and Appendix A. Users accept terms permitting public release, submit live prompts to an anonymous pair, may continue a multi-turn dialogue, and vote for model A, model B, tie, or both are bad; both conversations and the vote are retained. Non-uniform sampling favors similarly performing pairs. Identity-keyword filtering removes conversations that name models or companies, while OpenAI moderation flags unsafe requests (3 percent). An independent anomalous-IP analysis combines sequential p-values with Fisher's method, performs five random checks among votes 1–100, validates 25 anomalous and 25 normal users, and is not a ranking-input filter. The 2024-01-21 paper snapshot contains about 240K votes from over 90K users, over 50 models, and over 100 languages (77 percent English), with 1–2K recent valid votes per day. Topic analysis uses 1,536-dimensional text-embedding-3-small vectors, UMAP to five dimensions, HDBSCAN minimum cluster size 32, and GPT-4-Turbo labels from ten sampled prompts to obtain 600 clusters. Vote-quality validation blindly relabels 160 battles and observes 72.8–83.1-percent crowd-expert agreement. Ranking inverse-weights non-uniform pair sampling, fits reweighted Bradley–Terry coefficients, and uses sandwich intervals for approximate ranks. Official FastChat snapshot 587d5cf is later than the paper and advertises larger live counts and Elo terminology; those later changes are excluded from the paper snapshot, whose ranking contract is BT.
